query:
SELECT ci."clientId" AS "client_id!", c.username AS "username!", c.uuid AS "uuid!",
                      c.banned AS "banned!", c."expireAt" AS "expire_at: NaiveDateTime",
                      c."trafficLimit" AS "traffic_limit!", c."usedTraffic" AS "used_traffic!"
               FROM "ClientInbound" ci
               JOIN "Client" c ON c.id = ci."clientId"
               WHERE ci."inboundId" = $1 AND ci.enable = true
               ORDER BY ci."createdAt" ASC, ci.id ASC
